_about: How the patcher treats a chest whose item changes. Tune after in-game tests.

get_events._about: A chest's GetEventName is a scene. 'location' scenes belong to the spot (story, minigames, Navi) and always stay. Every other scene is an item scene scripted at its vanilla spot: it is removed when the chest's item changes and is never moved with an item (moving Get_StoneOfForest_GetSword teleported Link back to the vanilla sword chest).

chest_size._about: OFF by default (plan option chest_size: keep). I tested it in game: a converted chest keeps the other type's opening scene and plays no animation, and the chest should decide the animation anyway. With chest_size: match_contents, standard chests switch style to match their new item, like vanilla: big chest for equipment, maps, compasses and heart pieces; boss-key chest for boss keys; small chest for rupees, ammo, small keys and other junk. Chests not listed in 'styles' (invisible Lens chests, treasure-game chests, the A_04/A_06 variants) keep their look.
